methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The broader sector comp universe includes one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, notably Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity. However, the peer-median valuation method is not applicable here due to insufficient narrow comparables—zero same-stage robotics peers, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-tier targets were identified, falling short of the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for statistical reliability.

Given the scarcity of precisely matched comparables at the pre-seed stage in this sector, traditional multiples-based triangulation cannot be meaningfully applied. The broader eight-company peer set exists but lacks sufficient homogeneity in stage, valuation tier, or funding trajectory to support a defensible median or mean benchmark. Reliance on the full-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity across seed, Series A, and later-stage robotics companies.

Without applicable triangulation methods and undisclosed prior fundraising, this valuation presents a constrained analytical foundation. Any valuation estimate would require forward-looking methods (discounted cash flow, venture capital method) anchored to specific revenue or commercialization milestones, neither of which are provided in the current dataset. The analysis supports deferring quantitative valuation until either: comparable pre-seed robotics data emerges, or company-specific unit economics and go-to-market traction are disclosed.
